title: quiz_scoring
description: One row per quiz submission: the per-submission score summary. Source table data/tables/quiz_scoring.csv. Rolls up to the `submissions.json` records the enrichment template consumes; keyed to details.csv by (quizId, submission_id).

quizId.description: Quiz this submission belongs to. Foreign key to quiz_meta.quizId / quiz_structure.quizId.

submission_id.description: Unique identifier for this submission. Foreign key referenced by details.submission_id.

displayName.description: Respondent's display name; the literal 'Anonymous' when the submission is anonymous.

email.description: Respondent email. Anonymous submissions carry a generated placeholder address (temp@... .com).

isOwner.description: Whether the respondent is the quiz owner. Always False in the current data.

correctAnswers.description: Number of correct answers in this submission.

incorrectAnswers.description: Number of incorrect answers in this submission.

scorePct.description: Score as a percentage, 0-100 (100 * correctAnswers / totalAnswered).

timeSeconds.description: Time taken to complete the submission, in seconds.
